local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
while not player do
	task.wait(0.1)
	player = Players.LocalPlayer
end

local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 999)
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(newCharacter)
	character = newCharacter
	task.wait(0.5)
	local hum = newCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if hum then hum.PlatformStand = false end
end)
 
local isFlying = false
local speed = 1
local moveUp = false
local moveDown = false

screenGui.Name = "UltraFlyGuiV8_5"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.DisplayOrder = 999
screenGui.Parent = playerGui

---------------------------------------------------
-- 工具函數
---------------------------------------------------
local function getVehicleSeat()
	if not character then return nil end
	local hum = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if hum and hum.SeatPart then
		return hum.SeatPart
	end
	return nil
end

local function getTorso()
	if not character then return nil end
	return character.PrimaryPart or character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or character:FindFirstChild("Torso")
end

local function removeAllPhysics()
	local seat = getVehicleSeat()
	if seat then
		for _, v in ipairs(seat:GetDescendants()) do
			if v.Name == "FlyVelocity" or v.Name == "FlyGyro" or v.Name == "FlyWeld" then
				v:Destroy()
			end
		end
		local model = seat:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
		if model then
			for _, v in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
				if v.Name == "FlyWeld" then
					v:Destroy()
				end
			end
		end
	end
	
	local torso = getTorso()
	if torso then
		for _, v in ipairs(torso:GetChildren()) do
			if v.Name == "FlyVelocity" or v.Name == "FlyGyro" then
				v:Destroy()
			end
		end
	end
end

local function disableFly()
	isFlying = false
	moveUp = false
	moveDown = false
	upButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 60, 200)
	downButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 40, 180)
	flyButton.Text = "Fly"
	flyButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 180, 100)
	removeAllPhysics()
	if character then
		local hum = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if hum then hum.PlatformStand = false end
	end
end

local function setupFlyPhysics()
	removeAllPhysics()
	local seat = getVehicleSeat()
	local cameraCF = camera.CFrame
	
	if seat then
		-- 確保車輛所有零件都解鎖（Unanchored）並牢牢焊接給駕駛座
		local model = seat:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
		if model then
			for _, part in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
				if part:IsA("BasePart") and part ~= seat then
					part.Anchored = false -- 防止零件被鎖死在原地
					local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
					weld.Name = "FlyWeld"
					weld.Part0 = seat
					weld.Part1 = part
					weld.Parent = seat
				end
			end
		end

		local bg = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
		bg.Name = "FlyGyro"
		bg.P = 1e5
		bg.maxTorque = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
		bg.cframe = cameraCF
		bg.Parent = seat
		
		local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
		bv.Name = "FlyVelocity"
		bv.maxForce = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
		bv.velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0.1, 0)
		bv.Parent = seat
	else
		-- 角色本體飛行模式
		if character then
			local hum = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if hum then hum.PlatformStand = true end
		end
		
		local torso = getTorso()
		if not torso then return end
		
		local bg = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
		bg.Name = "FlyGyro"
		bg.P = 1e5
		bg.maxTorque = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
		bg.cframe = cameraCF
		bg.Parent = torso
		
		local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
		bv.Name = "FlyVelocity"
		bv.maxForce = Vector3.new(9e9, 9e9, 9e9)
		bv.velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0.1, 0)
		bv.Parent = torso
	end
end

local function disableFly()
	isFlying = false
	moveUp = false
	moveDown = false
	upButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 60, 200)
	downButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 40, 180)
	flyButton.Text = "Fly"
	flyButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 180, 100)
	removeAllPhysics()
	
	-- 關閉飛行時恢復正常人形狀態
	if character then
		local hum = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if hum then 
			hum.PlatformStand = false 
		end
	end
end

---------------------------------------------------
-- 按鈕事件
---------------------------------------------------
flyButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	isFlying = not isFlying
	if isFlying then
		flyButton.Text = "Stop"
		flyButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50)
		setupFlyPhysics()
	else
		disableFly()
	end
end)

flyupButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() speed = speed + 1 contentText.Text = tostring(speed) end)
flydownButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() speed = math.max(speed - 1, 1) contentText.Text = tostring(speed) end)

upButton.InputBegan:Connect(function(input) 
	if isFlying and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then 
		moveUp = true 
		upButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0) 
	end 
end)
upButton.InputEnded:Connect(function(input) 
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then 
		moveUp = false 
		upButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 60, 200) 
	end 
end)

downButton.InputBegan:Connect(function(input) 
	if isFlying and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then 
		moveDown = true 
		downButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0) 
	end 
end)
downButton.InputEnded:Connect(function(input) 
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then 
		moveDown = false 
		downButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 40, 180) 
	end 
end)

local isMinimized = false
smallButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	isMinimized = not isMinimized
	for _, child in ipairs(mainFrame:GetChildren()) do
		if child ~= smallButton and child ~= titleBar and child ~= closeButton then 
			child.Visible = not isMinimized 
		end
	end
	if isMinimized then 
		mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 30) 
		smallButton.Text = "[]" 
	else 
		mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 60) 
		smallButton.Text = "_" 
	end
end)

closeButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() disableFly() screenGui:Destroy() end)

---------------------------------------------------
-- 核心飛行計算（修正飄移 + 純 Y 軸上下控制）
---------------------------------------------------
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	if not isFlying then return end
	
	local seat = getVehicleSeat()
	local targetPart = seat or getTorso()
	if not targetPart then return end
	
	local realSpeed = speed * 50
	local cameraCF = camera.CFrame
	local cameraLook = cameraCF.LookVector   -- 完整的 3D 視線方向 (含 X, Y, Z)
	local cameraRight = cameraCF.RightVector -- 完整的 3D 側向方向 (含 X, Y, Z)

	local bg = targetPart:FindFirstChild("FlyGyro")
	local bv = targetPart:FindFirstChild("FlyVelocity")
	
	if not bg or not bv then
		setupFlyPhysics()
		return
	end

	local moveDir = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	local isMoving = false

	-- 直接使用完整 3D 向量，實現 XYZ 軸自由飛行
	if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then moveDir = moveDir + cameraLook isMoving = true end
	if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then moveDir = moveDir - cameraLook isMoving = true end
	if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then moveDir = moveDir - cameraRight isMoving = true end
	if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then moveDir = moveDir + cameraRight isMoving = true end

	-- 支援手把或移動端搖桿方向
	local hum = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not isMoving and hum and hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.1 then
		local rawDir = hum.MoveDirection
		local relForward = rawDir:Dot(cameraLook)
		local relRight = rawDir:Dot(cameraRight)
		moveDir = (cameraLook * relForward + cameraRight * relRight)
		isMoving = true
	end

	local flyVel = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
	if isMoving and moveDir.Magnitude > 0 then
		flyVel = moveDir.Unit * realSpeed
	end

	-- 上下控制鍵（Space / LeftShift 或 UI 按鈕）
	local verticalOffset = 0
	if moveUp or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then
		verticalOffset = realSpeed
	elseif moveDown or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then
		verticalOffset = -realSpeed
	end

	-- 結合 3D 移動與垂直升降
  bv.velocity = flyVel + Vector3.new(0, verticalOffset, 0)
	bg.cframe = cameraCF
end)

---------------------------------------------------
-- UI 拖曳邏輯
---------------------------------------------------
local dragging = false
local dragStart = nil
local startPos = nil

UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		local guiObjects = playerGui:GetGuiObjectsAtPosition(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
		local clickedTitle = false
		for _, obj in pairs(guiObjects) do if obj == titleBar then clickedTitle = true break end end
		if not clickedTitle then return end
		dragging = true
		dragStart = input.Position
		startPos = mainFrame.Position
		local conn
		conn = input.Changed:Connect(function()
			if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then dragging = false conn:Disconnect() end
		end)
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		if dragging and dragStart and startPos then
			local delta = input.Position - dragStart
			mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
		end
	end
end)

--==================================================
-- CONFIGURATION AND ASSET DOWNLOAD
--==================================================

-- Define the remote music URL and the local file name.
local url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/helloguyswelcometoanewvideo/musics-foruse-someday/main/ladancinamuchodance.mp3"
local file = "ladancinamuchodance.mp3"

-- Download the music only if the file does not already exist.
if not isfile(file) then
    local data = game:HttpGet(url)

    -- Validate the downloaded data before saving it.
    if #data >= 1000 then
        writefile(file, data)
    end
end


--==================================================
-- SERVICE INITIALIZATION
--==================================================

-- Get the Roblox services required by the script.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")

-- Store a reference to the local player.
local player = Players.LocalPlayer


--==================================================
-- LOADING NOTIFICATION
--==================================================

-- Display a notification when the controls are initialized.
game.StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {
    Title = "loading..",
    Text = "Dance controls loaded",
    Duration = 15
})

-- Allow time for the notification to appear.
task.wait(3)


--==================================================
-- MUSIC INITIALIZATION
--==================================================

-- Create and configure the background music instance.
local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
sound.SoundId = getcustomasset(file)
sound.Volume = 2
sound.Looped = true
sound.Parent = SoundService


--==================================================
-- HELPER FUNCTIONS
--==================================================

-- Resolve an animation asset into its AnimationId.
-- Return the original asset ID if no Animation object is found.
local function anim2track(asset_id)
    local objs = game:GetObjects(asset_id)

    for i = 1, #objs do
        if objs[i]:IsA("Animation") then
            return objs[i].AnimationId
        end
    end

    return asset_id
end

-- Get the current character's Humanoid.
-- Wait for the character to spawn if necessary.
local function getHumanoid()
    local char = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
    return char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
end


--==================================================
-- ANIMATION ASSET CONFIGURATION
--==================================================

-- Load the asset IDs for the three dance animations.
local animid = anim2track("rbxassetid://129991743366120")
local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
animation.AnimationId = animid

local anim2id = anim2track("rbxassetid://103108681887836")
local animation2 = Instance.new("Animation")
animation2.AnimationId = anim2id

local anim3id = anim2track("rbxassetid://112931882473990")
local animation3 = Instance.new("Animation")
animation3.AnimationId = anim3id


--==================================================
-- ANIMATION TRACK REFERENCES
--==================================================

-- Store the AnimationTrack objects after they are loaded.
local track
local track2
local track3


--==================================================
-- ANIMATION LOADING
--==================================================

-- Create an Animator if needed and load all three animations.
local function loadAnimations()
    local humanoid = getHumanoid()

    -- Find the existing Animator or create a new one.
    local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")

    if not animator then
        animator = Instance.new("Animator")
        animator.Parent = humanoid
    end

    -- Load each animation and assign its playback priority.
    track = animator:LoadAnimation(animation)
    track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Movement

    track2 = animator:LoadAnimation(animation2)
    track2.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Movement

    track3 = animator:LoadAnimation(animation3)
    track3.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Movement
end

-- Initialize the animation tracks.
loadAnimations()


--==================================================
-- PLAYBACK STATE
--==================================================

-- Track whether playback is enabled and which dance is selected.
local playing = true
local activeDance = 1


--==================================================
-- ANIMATION CONTROL FUNCTIONS
--==================================================

-- Stop all currently loaded dance animations.
local function stopAnimations()
    if track then track:Stop() end
    if track2 then track2:Stop() end
    if track3 then track3:Stop() end
end

-- Play the selected dance and stop the other animations.
local function playDance(index)
    -- Prevent dance animations from playing when playback is disabled.
    if not playing then return end

    if index == 1 then
        if track2 then track2:Stop() end
        if track3 then track3:Stop() end

        -- Start the first dance only if it is not already playing.
        if track and not track.IsPlaying then
            track:Play()
        end

    elseif index == 2 then
        if track then track:Stop() end
        if track3 then track3:Stop() end

        -- Start the second dance only if it is not already playing.
        if track2 and not track2.IsPlaying then
            track2:Play()
        end

    elseif index == 3 then
        if track then track:Stop() end
        if track2 then track2:Stop() end

        -- Start the third dance only if it is not already playing.
        if track3 and not track3.IsPlaying then
            track3:Play()
        end
    end

    -- Save the currently selected dance index.
    activeDance = index
end


--==================================================
-- MUSIC AND ANIMATION PLAYBACK TOGGLE
--==================================================

-- Toggle music and dance playback on or off.
local function togglePlayback()
    playing = not playing

    if playing then
        -- Resume the music and the currently selected dance.
        sound:Play()
        playDance(activeDance)
    else
        -- Stop the music and all dance animations.
        sound:Stop()
        stopAnimations()
    end
end


--==================================================
-- INITIAL PLAYBACK
--==================================================

-- Start the background music and the first dance.
sound:Play()

if track then
    track:Play()
end


--==================================================
-- CHARACTER RESPAWN HANDLING
--==================================================

-- Reload animation tracks when the player respawns.
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
    task.wait(1)

    loadAnimations()

    -- Resume the selected dance if playback is enabled.
    if playing then
        playDance(activeDance)
    end
end)


--==================================================
-- MOBILE GUI INITIALIZATION
--==================================================

-- Get the player's GUI container.
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

-- Remove an existing copy to prevent duplicate interfaces.
local oldGui = playerGui:FindFirstChild("DanceMobileControls")

if oldGui then
    oldGui:Destroy()
end


--==================================================
-- SCREEN GUI CONFIGURATION
--==================================================

-- Create the main screen interface.
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "DanceMobileControls"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
gui.DisplayOrder = 10000
gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Global
gui.Parent = playerGui


--==================================================
-- CONTROL PANEL LAYOUT
--==================================================

-- Create a transparent panel to hold the control buttons.
local panel = Instance.new("Frame")
panel.Name = "DancePanel"
panel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
panel.Position = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 8)
panel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 60, 0, 220)
panel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
panel.BorderSizePixel = 0
panel.Parent = gui

-- Arrange the buttons vertically with consistent spacing.
local layout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
layout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 5)
layout.HorizontalAlignment = Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Center
layout.VerticalAlignment = Enum.VerticalAlignment.Top
layout.Parent = panel


--==================================================
-- REUSABLE BUTTON FACTORY
--==================================================

-- Create a styled text button and connect its callback.
local function makeButton(label, callback)
    local button = Instance.new("TextButton")

    -- Configure the button's identity and dimensions.
    button.Name = "Button" .. label
    button.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 48)

    -- Configure the button's appearance.
    button.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    button.BorderSizePixel = 0
    button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    button.Text = label
    button.TextScaled = true
    button.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold

    -- Enable interaction and configure rendering order.
    button.Active = true
    button.Selectable = true
    button.ZIndex = 100
    button.Parent = panel

    -- Add a colored outline to the button.
    local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
    stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80)
    stroke.Thickness = 1.5
    stroke.Transparency = 0
    stroke.Parent = button

    -- Add rounded corners to the button.
    local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
    corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
    corner.Parent = button

    -- Execute the supplied callback when the button is activated.
    button.Activated:Connect(callback)

    return button
end


--==================================================
-- DANCE SELECTION BUTTONS
--==================================================

-- Select dance animation 1.
-- Pressing the same button again does not stop the animation.
makeButton("1", function()
    playDance(1)
end)

-- Select dance animation 2.
makeButton("2", function()
    playDance(2)
end)

-- Select dance animation 3.
makeButton("3", function()
    playDance(3)
end)

		ASH.fogBackup.ClockTime = ASH.Lighting.ClockTime

		ASH.Lighting.Brightness = 0
		ASH.Lighting.ClockTime = 0
		ASH.Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
		ASH.Lighting.FogColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
		ASH.Lighting.FogStart = 0
		ASH.Lighting.FogEnd = 30

		local existingAtmos = ASH.Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")
		if existingAtmos then existingAtmos:Destroy() end

		local customAtmos = Instance.new("Atmosphere")
		customAtmos.Name = "ASH_DarkAtmosphere"
		customAtmos.Density = 0.98
		customAtmos.Offset = 0
		customAtmos.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
		customAtmos.Decay = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
		customAtmos.Glare = 0
		customAtmos.Haze = 10
		customAtmos.Parent = ASH.Lighting

		local char = ASH.player.Character
		if not char or not char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end

		local shadowModel = Instance.new("Model")
		shadowModel.Name = "R6ShadowMonster"

		local blackColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
		local plasticMat = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic

		local function createLimb(name, size)
			local part = Instance.new("Part")
			part.Name = name
			part.Size = size
			part.Color = blackColor
			part.Material = plasticMat
			part.CanCollide = false
			part.Anchored = true
			part.Parent = shadowModel
			return part
		end

		local torso = createLimb("Torso", Vector3.new(2, 2, 1))
		local head = createLimb("Head", Vector3.new(1.2, 1.2, 1.2))
		local leftArm = createLimb("Left Arm", Vector3.new(1, 2, 1))
		local rightArm = createLimb("Right Arm", Vector3.new(1, 2, 1))
		local leftLeg = createLimb("Left Leg", Vector3.new(1, 2, 1))
		local rightLeg = createLimb("Right Leg", Vector3.new(1, 2, 1))

		local eye1 = Instance.new("Part")
		eye1.Name = "LeftEye"
		eye1.Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
		eye1.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
		eye1.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
		eye1.CanCollide = false
		eye1.Anchored = true
		eye1.Parent = shadowModel

		local eye2 = eye1:Clone()
		eye2.Name = "RightEye"
		eye2.Parent = shadowModel

		shadowModel.Parent = ASH.Workspace
		ASH.shadowModel = shadowModel

		local function updateR6CFrame(centerCFrame)
			torso.CFrame = centerCFrame
			head.CFrame = centerCFrame * CFrame.new(0, 1.5, 0)
			leftArm.CFrame = centerCFrame * CFrame.new(-1.5, 0, 0)
			rightArm.CFrame = centerCFrame * CFrame.new(1.5, 0, 0)
			leftLeg.CFrame = centerCFrame * CFrame.new(-0.5, -2, 0)
			rightLeg.CFrame = centerCFrame * CFrame.new(0.5, -2, 0)
			
			eye1.CFrame = head.CFrame * CFrame.new(-0.25, 0.15, -0.6)
			eye2.CFrame = head.CFrame * CFrame.new(0.25, 0.15, -0.6)
		end

		updateR6CFrame(char.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -20))

			while ASH.shadowEntityActive and shadowModel and torso.Parent do

				local pChar = ASH.player.Character
				if pChar and pChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and pChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
					local targetPos = pChar.HumanoidRootPart.Position
					local currentPos = torso.Position
					local direction = (targetPos - currentPos)
					local distance = direction.Magnitude

					if distance > 0.5 then
						local moveDir = direction.Unit
						local newPos = currentPos + (moveDir * speed * dt)
						local nextCFrame = CFrame.new(newPos, targetPos)
						
						updateR6CFrame(nextCFrame)

						if distance <= 3.5 then
							pChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid").Health = 0
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end)

		ASH.StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {Title = "ASH..-AYE Admin", Text = "Black Fog Active! Run!", Duration = 3})
	else
		if ASH.shadowThread then task.cancel(ASH.shadowThread) end
		if ASH.shadowModel then ASH.shadowModel:Destroy() end

		local customAtmos = ASH.Lighting:FindFirstChild("ASH_DarkAtmosphere")
		if customAtmos then customAtmos:Destroy() end

		ASH.Lighting.Brightness = ASH.fogBackup.Brightness or 1
		ASH.Lighting.ClockTime = ASH.fogBackup.ClockTime or 14
		ASH.Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = ASH.fogBackup.OutdoorAmbient or Color3.fromRGB(128, 128, 128)

		ASH.Lighting.FogStart = ASH.fogBackup.FogStart or 0
